X:1
T:O give me those pretty eyes
T:Garhwali song, a dialogue
C:traditional (Garhwal)
O:India, Garhwal (Himalaya)
R:song
S:Fox Strangways, The Music of Hindostan (1914), Ex. 97, p. 51
N:Tonic G (G Dorian with the one-flat signature). He and she sing alternate verses. The metre changes from 3/4 to 2/4 at "make". Check: bars 3 and 4.
M:3/4
L:1/8
Q:1/4=100
K:Gdor
%%style drone
G2 B c B c | c c c2 B B |[M:2/4] A2 B c | c2 c B | A2 B B | G2 G z |]
w: O give me those pret-ty eyes, And I'll make you the gift in re-turn of my own, dear.
N:2 (She): And if I give you my pretty eyes, Other lovers 'll laugh and 'll leave me alone, dear.
N:3 (He): Then O let me borrow them, And keep them safe till you need them again, dear.
N:4 (She): For six months you shall borrow them; Promise truly you'll give me them back then again, dear.
N:5 (He): What word is this of a bargaining! I will keep your eyes and your heart and your soul, dear.
